title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre
blurb: Three separate attempts to continue the 1974 original, each ignoring the others. The 2017 prequel reaches back furthest.

t90.t: Leatherface: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre III

t95.t: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Next Generation

t06.t: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Beginning

groups.title: The original series
groups.note: The 1974 film and its first three sequels, which hold together loosely.

groups.title: The 2003 remake
groups.note: A remake of the 1974 film, with The Beginning as its prequel.

groups.title: The Texas Chainsaw 3D timeline
groups.note: A direct sequel to the 1974 film, with Leatherface as its prequel.

groups.title: The 2022 sequel
groups.note: Another direct sequel to the 1974 film that ignores everything else.

note: Leatherface is a prequel to the 1974 film, while The Beginning is a prequel to the 2003 remake — two different origin stories for the same character. Texas Chainsaw 3D and the 2022 film are both direct sequels to 1974 that ignore each other, so the 1974 film is the place to start for either.
